test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_json_nested_paths_src (s String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_json_nested_paths_src SELECT concat('{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(g -> concat( '"group_name_', toString((number % 5) * 8 + g), '":{', '"attributes":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"attribute.key_', toString(i), '":', toString(number + i)), range(3)), ','), '},', '"details":{"nested_level":{', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('"detail_value_', toString(i), '":"v', toString(i), '"'), range(3)), ','), '}}', '}'), range(8)), ','), '}') FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT s::{json_type} FROM t_json_nested_paths_src FORMAT Null SETTINGS json_type_escape_dots_in_keys = {escape_dots}
